objectives.description: Exhaustive per-suite check: fixed temp path, real-tree writes, real git ops, fixed ports/sockets
objectives.note: 96 suites (baseline 95 + Phase 2's new suite). 93/96 use mktemp -d; 3 non-mktemp suites are read-only. Zero fixed ports/sockets. Two apparent risk hits individually verified safe (WORKDIR-scoped $TARGET; inert heredoc fixture text).

objectives.description: Name the load-sensitive set explicitly, search for other timing assertions
objectives.note: 4 load-sensitive suites confirmed: test-lake-build-guard.sh, test-state-write-concurrency.sh, test-state-write-regen-timing.sh (all named in plan), plus test-four-tier-conflict.sh (new finding, TASK_LOCK_RETRY_BUDGET_MS=5000). 8 other keyword-matching candidates individually ruled out.

test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh, test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh (both rsync ~16MB); test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh (CPU-heavy, sibling territory, no budget assertion). 17 suites git-init a mktemp-scoped fixture repo (moderate, not real-repo).

objectives.description: Produce the full audit table for Phase 5/7 use (not a separate report artifact)
objectives.note: 96-row verdict table (PARALLEL-SAFE / PARALLEL-SAFE(no-tmp) / RESOURCE-HEAVY / LOAD-SENSITIVE) saved under progress/ as supporting data, not specs/reports/ -- consumed by Phase 5's run-all.sh comment block and Phase 7's summary.

objectives.description: Decide whether any suite requires serialization
objectives.note: No suite has a fixed-resource collision against another specific suite (zero fixed ports/sockets/lock paths outside a suite's own fixture). The 4 load-sensitive suites should still be excluded from Phase 5's parallel pool as an ambient-load precaution, not a resource-collision requirement -- this distinction is recorded so Phase 5 does not conflate the two.
